sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
This checklist provides an indication of the evidence you will need to submit with your application.

We might ask you for additional evidence.

When you submit your application in ImmiAccount, you will also be provided with a list of documents you should attach. If evidence of English capacity and financial capacity are included on the list at this stage, they MUST be attached before you submit your application, or your application may be refused.

If you intend to do a package of courses, you must select the education provider offering the principal (final) course.

If you haven't decided on your education provider, you can leave the field blank or select 'My provider is not listed'.

A full list of education providers is set out in the Commonwealth Register of Institutions and Courses for Overseas Students (CRICOS). If your education provider is registered but not yet showing on the checklist, select the ‘my education provider is not listed’ option. It could take up to a month for an education provider to appear in the checklist from the date of that provider’s registration with CRICOS.

In addition to the documents we need, your education provider might have their own enrolment requirements.
